checklist.step: Maintain the governance policy inventory
actions: Keep the inventory current in the board portal: each policy, its executive owner, last board approval date, next review date and the Code of Conduct paragraph it satisfies.
Confirm the inventory covers the Code of Conduct-mandated set: risk management framework, conflicts of interest, outsourcing, remuneration, code of ethics and whistleblowing.
Add new policies the board adopts within 5 business days of the resolution.
Publish the inventory to the audit committee each quarter.
checklist.done: a current inventory maps every policy to owner, dates and Code of Conduct paragraph.

checklist.step: Start the annual cycle with a regulatory gap scan
actions: Each Q1, list BMA rule changes from the past year: Code of Conduct amendments, new guidance notes and Insurance Act amendments.
Map each change to the affected policies in the inventory and record 'no impact' conclusions explicitly.
Hand each affected policy owner the specific new text their redline must address.
File the gap scan with the cycle records.
checklist.done: a filed gap scan maps every rule change to affected policies or a reasoned no-impact.

checklist.step: Owner review and redline of each policy
actions: Coordinate each executive owner's review: policy operated as written, breaches during the year, and the gap-scan items to address.
Produce a tracked-changes redline in the document management repository, version-numbered against the approved master.
Attach an owner's memo summarizing changes and confirming operational adherence, or proposing no change with reasons.
Hold owners to a 20-business-day turnaround from cycle start.
checklist.done: every policy has a versioned redline and owner's memo inside 20 business days.

checklist.step: Legal review of redlines against the Code of Conduct
actions: Review each redline against the mapped Code of Conduct paragraphs and Schedule 2 criteria.
Update the mapping table where paragraph references moved in a BMA amendment.
Return legally deficient drafts to the owner with the specific paragraph the draft fails to satisfy.
Clear each draft in writing for board routing.
checklist.done: every redline carries written legal clearance and a current mapping table.

checklist.step: Route the policy suite to the board with a decision paper
actions: Package the cleared redlines, owner memos and mapping tables into the board pack via the board portal at least 5 business days before the meeting.
Write the decision paper: what changed, why, breaches noted during the year and the recommended resolution text per policy.
Schedule the approvals so the full suite completes before the s.8A Declaration signing date.
Flag to the chair any policy the board should debate rather than approve on consent.
checklist.done: the board pack contains the full suite with decision paper, timed ahead of the Declaration.

checklist.step: Obtain minuted board approval per policy
actions: Record a specific resolution per policy in the minutes: policy name, version number and approval date — no blanket 'suite approved' wording.
Minute any amendments the board makes from the floor and update the version before release.
Minute dissents and conflicts declared on any policy vote.
Update the inventory's approval and next-review dates the same week.
checklist.done: each policy shows a named, versioned resolution in approved minutes and an updated inventory row.

checklist.step: Publish approved versions and retire the old ones
actions: Replace the master copy in the document management repository with the board-approved version, watermarked with version and approval date.
Move superseded versions to the archive folder — never delete them.
Update the intranet policy page links and confirm they open the new versions.
Notify all staff of changed policies with a summary of what changed.
checklist.done: approved versions are live, superseded versions archived, and staff notified.

checklist.step: Roll out attestations for materially changed policies
actions: For policies with material changes (conflicts, ethics, whistleblowing), launch an attestation campaign in the learning management system to all in-scope staff.
Set a 30-day completion window with weekly chasers.
Report completion rates to the policy owner and escalate sub-95% functions to their executive.
File the completion report with the cycle records.
checklist.done: attestation campaigns for changed policies close at 95%+ with reports filed.

checklist.step: Handle event-driven reviews between cycles
actions: On a triggering event (BMA rule change, material breach, structural change), open an off-cycle review of the affected policy within 10 business days.
Complete redline, legal clearance and board approval within 90 days of the trigger.
Use a written-resolution approval where the next scheduled board meeting falls outside the 90 days.
Log the trigger, dates and approval on the inventory row.
checklist.done: every trigger shows an off-cycle review approved inside 90 days.

checklist.step: Monitor policy breaches and feed them to the cycle
actions: Log reported breaches of governance policies during the year with severity and disposition.
Report material breaches to the board at the next meeting, not the next cycle.
Compile the year's breach record per policy for the owner's annual review memo.
Track breach-driven policy changes to the next redline.
checklist.done: breaches are logged, reported at the right speed, and visible in the next review.

checklist.step: Track the suite against the Declaration timetable
actions: Maintain the cycle dashboard: per policy, the stage (owner review, legal, board, published) and days to its 12-month expiry.
Report the dashboard in every quarterly board pack.
Escalate any policy at risk of expiring unapproved to the chair at T-30.
Confirm to General Counsel, before the s.8A Declaration is signed, that no policy is lapsed.
checklist.done: the dashboard shows no lapsed policy and a pre-Declaration confirmation is on record.

checklist.step: Log and remediate cycle exceptions
actions: Raise an issue for any policy past its clock, any unminuted approval or any missed 90-day event review.
Assign root cause and a catch-up date; lapsed policies get an interim written-resolution plan.
Obtain Corporate Secretary sign-off at closure and board-chair acknowledgement for lapses.
Review open exceptions at each quarterly board pack build.
checklist.done: every exception is tracked to a signed-off closure with lapses acknowledged by the chair.

checklist.step: Verify mid-year operation of each approved policy
actions: Each Q3, sample one operating requirement from every approved policy (e.g. the conflicts register updated per the conflicts policy, outsourcing register per the outsourcing policy) and confirm it operated as written.
Collect the operating evidence from the policy owner — register extracts, approval records or committee papers named in the policy.
Record pass/fail per policy on the cycle dashboard and feed failures into the owner's next annual review memo.
Escalate any policy demonstrably not operating to the Corporate Secretary within 5 business days.
checklist.done: every approved policy shows a Q3 operating check with evidence and failures escalated.

checklist.step: Archive the cycle record
actions: Archive the year's gap scan, redlines, owner memos, mapping tables, resolutions and attestation reports under REG-057/C14/<year>.
Apply the 10-year retention label and read-only flag.
Verify retrieval by policy name and approval date.
Reference the archive in the Declaration support file (REG-057-C12).
checklist.done: the full cycle record is archived read-only and referenced in the Declaration support file.

checklist.step: Brief new directors on the policy suite
actions: Include the current policy suite and inventory in every new director's induction pack (with REG-057-C11).
Walk the director through the approval cycle and their attestation obligations.
Capture the director's acknowledgement of the conflicts and ethics policies before their first vote.
Record the briefing in the director register.
checklist.done: every new director shows a recorded suite briefing and conflicts/ethics acknowledgement.

testing.step: Build the population from the inventory and minutes
actions: Extract the policy inventory as at year end with approval and next-review dates.
Extract every policy-approval resolution from the year's approved minutes.
Extract the year's logged BMA rule changes from the gap scan and compliance horizon log.
testing.done: inventory, resolutions and rule-change lists form the documented population.

testing.step: Reconcile inventory claims to minuted resolutions
actions: Match every inventory approval date to a specific named resolution in the minutes.
Match every minuted policy resolution back to an inventory row.
List any approval date with no resolution, or resolution with no inventory update, as an exception.
testing.done: inventory and minutes reconcile both directions or exceptions are listed.

testing.step: Recompute the 12-month clock for every policy
actions: Compute days between successive approval dates for each policy across the year.
Flag any interval exceeding 12 months and check whether a tracked exception with chair acknowledgement exists.
Verify the whole suite carried in-date approvals on the s.8A Declaration signing date.
testing.done: every clock is recomputed and Declaration-date coverage is verified.

testing.step: Sample policies for content verification
actions: Draw a seeded sample of 5 policies including at least one Code of Conduct-mandated policy and one that had a material redline.
Record seed, population and selection date.
Include any policy that lapsed during the year.
testing.done: a reproducible 5-policy sample including lapses is documented.

testing.step: Verify the published version matches the approved version
actions: For each sampled policy, compare the live master in the document management repository to the version number in the approving resolution.
Diff the live text against the board-pack redline to confirm floor amendments were incorporated.
Any live version differing from the approved version is an exception.
testing.done: live masters match approved versions exactly for every sampled policy.

testing.step: Re-perform the Code of Conduct mapping on one policy
actions: Take the sampled mandated policy and independently map its sections to the current BMA Insurance Code of Conduct paragraphs.
Compare to the filed mapping table.
Flag unmapped Code requirements as content exceptions for Legal Counsel.
testing.done: an independent mapping matches the filed table or content gaps are flagged.

testing.step: Test event-driven review responsiveness
actions: For each logged BMA rule change, verify a mapped review or explicit no-impact conclusion exists.
Recompute days from trigger to board approval for off-cycle reviews against the 90-day standard.
List unassessed triggers or overruns as exceptions.
testing.done: every trigger shows an assessment and off-cycle approvals fall inside 90 days.

testing.step: Verify attestation campaign evidence
actions: For the sampled materially changed policy, pull the LMS campaign completion report.
Verify the campaign population matched in-scope staff and the completion rate met 95%.
Trace two named completions to individual LMS records.
testing.done: the campaign report verifies against LMS records at the required rate.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause and owner
actions: Raise one issue per exception naming the policy and failed attribute.
Assign root cause (clock lapse, minute gap, version drift, mapping gap) and an owner.
Flag anything contradicting the signed Declaration of Compliance to General Counsel.
Set remediation dates and carry open items forward.
testing.done: all exceptions are tracked with root cause, owner and Declaration-impact flags.

testing.step: Conclude with independent sign-off
actions: State the conclusion against the zero-lapsed-policy and minuted-approval thresholds.
Have the Chief Audit Executive, owner of none of the policies, sign the workpaper.
Report to the audit committee before the next Declaration signing.
File the workpaper under REG-057/C14/testing.
testing.done: a signed conclusion is filed and reported ahead of the next Declaration.

checklist.step: Publish the close calendar and refresh the mapping table

Download the BMA's current SFR instructions and prescribed-form templates and diff them against last year's.
Update the GL-to-statutory mapping table for any changed form line, new note requirement or chart-of-accounts change.
Have the Controller approve the updated mapping table before the Q1 close.

checklist.step: Execute the GL close in SAP

Verify subledger-to-GL tie-outs for premiums, claims, reinsurance and investments from the interface control reports.
Lock the period so no post-close journals land without Controller approval.
Export the closed trial balance by company code to the consolidation tool.
checklist.done: the period is closed and locked with subledgers tied and the trial balance exported.

checklist.step: Complete BlackLine reconciliations before statement assembly
actions: Complete every assigned account reconciliation in BlackLine by workday 10, attaching support for each reconciling item.
Age reconciling items and clear or escalate anything older than 60 days.
Route each reconciliation to its independent approver inside BlackLine.
Report unreconciled accounts above the materiality threshold to the Controller daily from workday 10.
checklist.done: all reconciliations are approver-signed in BlackLine with no over-threshold item unescalated.

checklist.step: Run consolidation and intercompany eliminations
actions: Load the closed trial balances into the consolidation tool and run the intercompany matching report.
Clear intercompany mismatches above the rounding rule with the counterparty accountant before eliminating.
Post elimination and minority-interest entries in the tool, never in the GL.
Lock the consolidation version for the period.
checklist.done: a locked consolidation version exists with intercompany mismatches cleared.

checklist.step: Pull actuarial and investment balances from their owners
actions: Obtain the signed reserve summary from the Reserving Actuary (per REG-057-C09) and agree booked reserves to it.
Obtain the investment valuation file from the Investment Operations Manager with pricing-source evidence for level-3 assets.
Obtain the reinsurance recoverable schedule from the Reinsurance Accountant with counterparty balances confirmed.
Log each handoff with its delivery date against the close calendar.
checklist.done: reserves, investments and recoverables agree to owner-signed schedules logged on the calendar.

checklist.step: Populate the prescribed statutory forms
actions: Populate Form 1 (statutory balance sheet), Form 2 (statutory income statement) and the supporting schedules from the locked consolidation via the mapping table — no manual keying outside the mapping.
Complete the statutory notes per the Insurance Accounts Regulations 1980 notes checklist, including related-party and encumbered-asset disclosures.
Run the form's internal cross-casts: total assets equal liabilities plus capital, income statement rolls into retained earnings.
Store the populated set in the financial reporting repository with version control.
checklist.done: prescribed forms are populated through the mapping table, cross-cast clean, and versioned.

checklist.step: Prepare the s.17A GAAP financial statements
actions: Assemble the GAAP statements (balance sheet, income statement, equity, cash flows, notes) from the same locked consolidation version.
Reconcile GAAP equity to statutory capital and surplus on the standing bridge schedule, explaining every bridge item.
Complete the GAAP disclosure checklist for the reporting framework the entity elected under s.17A.
Version the set alongside the statutory forms.
checklist.done: GAAP statements exist with a fully explained GAAP-to-statutory bridge and completed disclosure checklist.

checklist.step: Tie statutory statements to solvency inputs
actions: Agree the statutory capital and surplus figure to the opening data of the BSCR and EBS prepared by Capital Management.
Confirm the minimum solvency margin and enhanced capital requirement calculations start from the same locked figures.
Document the tie-out so the SFR package is internally consistent across statements and capital schedules.
Flag any difference to the Controller before certification.
checklist.done: statutory capital ties to the BSCR/EBS inputs with the tie-out documented.

checklist.step: Run the analytical review
actions: Compare each statement line to prior quarter and prior year, investigating movements beyond 10% or the materiality threshold.
Obtain written line-owner explanations for flagged movements and attach them to the review file.
Check ratio sanity: loss ratio, expense ratio, investment yield against plan and prior periods.
Sign the analytical review memo.
checklist.done: a signed analytical review memo explains every flagged movement.

checklist.step: Execute the review-and-certification ladder
actions: Route the statement set: preparer sign, Statutory Reporting Manager review, Controller review, CFO certification, each dated in sequence.
Clear every open review note before the next rung signs — no 'subject to' certifications.
Present the annual set to the audit committee before auditor handoff.
File the completed certification page with the set.
checklist.done: a dated four-rung sign-off chain and audit-committee presentation are on file.

checklist.step: Hand off to the approved auditor on schedule
actions: Deliver the certified annual statutory and GAAP sets with supporting schedules to the BMA-approved auditor by end of February.
Log every auditor information request and answer within 5 business days through the audit request tracker.
Track audit adjustments; post accepted ones through the consolidation tool with Controller approval and re-run affected forms.
Obtain the signed audit opinion in time for the April 30 SFR filing.
checklist.done: the auditor received the certified set on time and the signed opinion is in hand pre-filing.

checklist.step: Support quarterly management filings where required
actions: For entities with quarterly BMA filing obligations, assemble the quarterly unaudited statutory set from the workday-15 close.
Apply the same mapping table and cross-cast checks as the annual forms.
Obtain Controller sign-off before releasing figures to Regulatory Reporting (REG-057-C16).
Log the release date against the close calendar.
checklist.done: quarterly sets are mapping-table-built, cross-cast, signed and released on calendar.

checklist.step: Log and remediate close exceptions
actions: Raise an issue for any missed workday-15 close, over-threshold unreconciled account at sign-off, or manual entry outside the mapping table.
Assign root cause and a remediation owner in the close team.
Obtain CFO sign-off at closure; notify the audit committee of any restatement.
Trend exceptions quarterly to catch structural close weaknesses.
checklist.done: close exceptions are tracked, CFO-signed at closure, and trended quarterly.

checklist.step: Archive the statement evidence set
actions: Archive per period under REG-057/C15/<year>-<period>: statement sets, mapping table version, reconciliation sign-off pages, analytical review and certification pages.
Apply the 10-year retention label and read-only flag.
Verify retrieval by entity, period and form.
Record the archive link on the close calendar task.
checklist.done: each period's evidence set is archived read-only with retrieval verified.

checklist.step: Refresh the procedure for regulatory change
actions: Monitor BMA notices for changes to the Insurance Accounts Regulations, SFR instructions or prescribed forms each quarter.
Update the mapping table, note checklist and procedure within one close cycle of a landed change.
Brief the close team on changes at the pre-close meeting.
Record the change assessment even when nothing lands.
checklist.done: quarterly change assessments exist and landed changes reach the mapping table within one cycle.

testing.step: Build the population of statement sets
actions: List the required sets for the year: four quarterly and one annual statutory set plus the s.17A GAAP set, per Bermuda entity.
Pull the archived sets from the financial reporting repository.
Any required set missing from the archive is an automatic exception.
testing.done: a required-vs-archived matrix exists with gaps listed.

testing.step: Select the test scope
actions: Take the annual statutory and GAAP sets at 100% plus one seeded random quarterly set.
Record seed, population and selection date in the workpaper.
Include any period that carried a restatement.
testing.done: a reproducible scope covering the annual sets and one quarter is documented.

testing.step: Tie statement figures back to the locked consolidation
actions: For 15 sampled form lines across Form 1 and Form 2, trace the figure through the mapping table to the locked consolidation version.
Verify the consolidation version id matches the one cited in the statement set.
Any line reachable only through a manual entry outside the mapping table is an exception.
testing.done: all sampled lines trace through the mapping table to the locked version.

testing.step: Re-run the cross-casts and the GAAP-statutory bridge
actions: Recompute the form cross-casts: assets vs liabilities plus capital, income roll-forward to retained earnings.
Recompute the GAAP-equity-to-statutory-capital bridge and verify every bridge item has an explanation.
List any cast failure or unexplained bridge item as an exception.
testing.done: cross-casts and the bridge recompute clean or failures are listed.

testing.step: Verify prescribed-form and note completeness
actions: Compare the filed form set against the BMA's current-year prescribed templates line by line.
Check the statutory notes against the Insurance Accounts Regulations 1980 notes checklist, including related-party and encumbered-asset notes.
List omitted lines or notes as exceptions.
testing.done: forms and notes match the prescribed templates with omissions listed.

testing.step: Verify reconciliation coverage at sign-off
actions: Pull the BlackLine completion report for the tested periods.
Verify every balance-sheet account was reconciled and approver-signed before the Controller's statement sign-off date.
Check no over-threshold reconciling item was open at certification without an exception record.
testing.done: BlackLine shows complete, approver-signed coverage pre-certification.

testing.step: Verify owner-schedule agreement for reserves, investments and recoverables
actions: Agree booked reserves to the Reserving Actuary's signed summary for the tested periods.
Agree investment balances to the valuation file and recoverables to the reinsurance schedule.
Verify the statutory capital figure ties to the BSCR/EBS opening data per the documented tie-out.
testing.done: all three owner schedules and the solvency tie-out agree with the statements.

testing.step: Verify the certification ladder and timeliness
actions: Check the four-rung sign-off chain is complete and correctly sequenced for each tested set.
Recompute close completion against workday 15 and the annual auditor handoff against end-February.
Verify the audit-committee presentation preceded auditor handoff for the annual set.
testing.done: sign-off chains and calendar deadlines verify for every tested set.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause and owner
actions: Raise one issue per exception naming the period, form line and failed attribute.
Assign root cause (mapping gap, manual entry, reconciliation lapse, calendar slip) and an owner.
Route anything affecting the filed SFR to the CFO and General Counsel same-day.
Set remediation dates and carry open items forward.
testing.done: all exceptions are tracked with root cause, owner and filing-impact escalation.

testing.step: Conclude with independent sign-off
actions: State the conclusion against the tie-out, completeness and certification thresholds.
Have the Chief Audit Executive, who prepared none of the statements, sign the workpaper.
Report to the audit committee before the SFR files.
File the workpaper under REG-057/C15/testing.
testing.done: a signed conclusion is filed and reported pre-filing.

Accountable obligation owner.value: Owns on-time transmission of the annual statutory financial return package (statutory statements, s.17A GAAP statements, BSCR schedules, Declaration of Compliance) to the BMA, and any parallel NAIC/state filings for US-licensed affiliates; escalation to the Chief Financial Officer

Citation verified against current regula.value: Yes — Insurance Act 1978 s.17 & s.18 (statutory financial return and its filing), s.17A (audited GAAP / general purpose financial statements) and the BMA's current-year filing instructions and fee notice, re-verified each January when the filing calendar is set

In-scope processes.value: Regulatory transmission: package assembly from the certified statement sets (REG-057-C15), BMA electronic filing within 4 months of year end, quarterly filings where the entity's class requires them, annual business fee payment by March 31, and NAIC-blank filings for US affiliates by March 1 (annual) and 45 days after quarter end

In-scope systems.value: Certified packages staged in the financial reporting repository; BMA e-filing portal for Bermuda submissions; NAIC internet filing for US-blank affiliates; confirmations logged on the filing tracker

Compliance procedure documented.value: Regulatory Filing Transmission Procedure — filing calendar per entity and class, package completeness checklist, portal submission steps, confirmation capture, extension-request path and fee payment

Compliance procedure approved.value: Approved by the Chief Financial Officer and Head of Compliance; reviewed each January against the BMA's published filing instructions

Filing/reporting deadlines tracked.value: BMA statutory financial return within 4 months of financial year end (April 30 for December 31), BMA annual business fee by March 31, quarterly returns where the class requires them, NAIC annual statement by March 1 and quarterlies within 45 days of quarter end for US affiliates

Deadline reminders configured.value: Tracker milestones at T-60/T-30/T-14/T-7/T-2 per filing line, alerting the Regulatory Reporting Manager, Statutory Reporting Manager and CFO; the T-14 alert triggers the go/no-go extension decision

Evidence retained per the retention requ.value: Filed packages, portal submission receipts, fee payment proofs and regulator acknowledgements retained 10 years under REG-057/C16 in the compliance evidence repository

Violations/exceptions logged with dispos.value: Any filing after its statutory date without a pre-approved extension, any rejected submission, and any late fee payment is logged with root cause, civil-penalty exposure and disposition

Remediation sign-off captured.value: The CFO signs off closure of every late-filing or rejection exception; General Counsel co-signs where a s.18 late filing requires BMA engagement

Test population (in-scope transactions,.value: Every regulatory filing due in the year per the filing calendar: BMA annual SFR package and fees per Bermuda entity, class-required quarterlies, and NAIC annual/quarterly statements per US affiliate

Pass/fail thresholds.value: Zero tolerance — any due filing transmitted after its statutory date without a BMA-granted extension is a fail; a single fail escalates to the CFO and audit committee

Compliance test frequency matched to the.value: Obligation is quarterly/annual; test runs annually in Q3 covering all of the prior filing season's transmissions

Independent reviewer (segregated from th.value: Reviewer must not have assembled or transmitted any tested filing

Evidence location for test results.value: Annual filing-timeliness test workpaper (calendar-vs-filed matrix, receipt verification, day-count recomputation) under REG-057/C16/testing

Regulator-ready documentation.value: The filing tracker with per-filing receipt folders, producible to the BMA or a state regulator within 2 business days

Regulator response path.value: The Regulatory Reporting Manager fronts filing-status questions; extension requests go to the entity's BMA supervisor before the due date; General Counsel clears any late-filing explanation

checklist.step: Build the annual filing calendar per entity and class
actions: Each January, list every filing due in the year: BMA SFR package per Bermuda entity (due 4 months after year end), class-required quarterly returns, the BMA annual business fee (March 31), and NAIC annual (March 1) and quarterly (45 days) statements per US affiliate.
Verify each entity's registration class and its class-specific deadline against the certificate of registration and the BMA's current filing instructions.
Enter each filing on the tracker with statutory cite, due date, package owner and transmission owner.
Have the Head of Compliance confirm calendar completeness before locking it.
checklist.done: a compliance-confirmed calendar with owners and class-verified deadlines is locked.

checklist.step: Configure the reminder ladder on every filing line
actions: Set T-60/T-30/T-14/T-7/T-2 alerts on each line, addressed to the package owner, the Regulatory Reporting Manager and, from T-14, the CFO.
Mark the T-14 alert as the go/no-go point: if the package will not be ready, the extension request must leave that week.
Test-fire one alert per cohort and confirm receipt.
Review alert assignments whenever an owner changes.
checklist.done: the ladder is live on every line with the T-14 go/no-go convention set.

checklist.step: Assemble the BMA SFR package from certified sources
actions: Pull only certified versions from the financial reporting repository: audited statutory statements, s.17A GAAP statements with the audit opinion, BSCR schedules from Capital Management, the actuarial opinion, and the executed s.8A Declaration of Compliance (REG-057-C12).
Run the package completeness checklist against the BMA's current SFR instructions, ticking each required component.
Verify version ids match the certified sets — no draft or superseded file enters the package.
Stage the package in the transmission folder with a manifest.
checklist.done: a manifested package of certified components passes the completeness checklist.

checklist.step: Second-person review of the staged package
actions: Re-run the completeness checklist independently against the staged manifest.
Open each file and verify entity name, financial year and signature pages are present and legible.
Compare headline figures (total assets, capital and surplus) across statements, BSCR and opinion for internal consistency.
Sign the transmission authorization on the tracker line.
checklist.done: an independent reviewer has signed transmission authorization on a verified package.

checklist.step: Transmit the SFR package via the BMA electronic filing portal
actions: Log in to the BMA's electronic filing portal with the entity's filing credentials and open the statutory filing submission for the financial year.
Upload each component to its designated slot per the portal's SFR structure and complete the portal's declaration screen.
Submit no later than the statutory date — 4 months after year end or the BMA-approved extended date.
Download the submission receipt showing timestamp and package contents immediately.
checklist.done: the portal receipt shows on-time submission of the full package.

checklist.step: Pay the BMA annual business fee by March 31
actions: Obtain the fee amount for the entity's class from the BMA's current fee schedule and confirm it with the Regulatory Reporting Manager.
Initiate the payment through treasury with value date no later than March 31, referencing the entity registration number.
Capture the payment confirmation and the BMA's receipt.
Attach both to the tracker's fee line.
checklist.done: the fee is value-dated by March 31 with confirmation and receipt attached.

checklist.step: File class-required quarterly returns
actions: For entities whose class requires quarterly filings, assemble the quarterly return from the Controller-signed quarterly set (REG-057-C15).
Transmit through the BMA portal by the class deadline and capture the receipt.
Update the tracker line with the receipt attached.
Escalate at T-7 if the quarterly set is not yet signed.
checklist.done: each class-required quarterly is transmitted on time with its receipt on the tracker.

checklist.step: File NAIC statements for US-licensed affiliates
actions: Prepare the NAIC annual statement blanks in the statutory reporting software, validating with the NAIC crosschecks before export.
Submit the annual statement to the NAIC internet filing site by March 1 and the quarterlies within 45 days of quarter end, plus any state-specific filings the domiciliary state requires.
Clear every crosscheck error or document the NAIC-accepted explanation before submission.
Capture the NAIC submission confirmations and state acknowledgements.
checklist.done: NAIC annual and quarterly filings are validated, submitted on time and confirmed.

checklist.step: Request extensions before the deadline, never after
actions: At the T-14 go/no-go, decide with the CFO whether any package will miss its date.
Where it will, submit a written extension request to the entity's BMA supervisor stating the reason and the committed filing date, before the statutory date.
Hold the BMA's written grant on the tracker line; a request alone does not move the deadline.
Re-set the tracker due date only to the granted date.
checklist.done: any at-risk filing shows a pre-deadline request and a written BMA grant before the date moved.

checklist.step: Handle portal rejections and resubmissions same-week
actions: Monitor the portal and the filing mailbox daily during filing season for rejection or deficiency notices.
Log any rejection as an exception, fix the named deficiency with the package owner, and resubmit within 5 business days.
Confirm the resubmission receipt supersedes the rejected one on the tracker.
Report rejections and their causes to the Regulatory Reporting Manager weekly.
checklist.done: every rejection is logged, cured and resubmitted within 5 business days.

checklist.step: Capture and file all confirmations
actions: File per filing under REG-057/C16/<year>/<entity>/<filing>: the transmitted package manifest, portal receipt, fee proof and any regulator acknowledgement.
Apply the 10-year retention label.
Link the folder on the tracker line before marking it Filed.
Sweep monthly for Filed lines lacking complete folders.
checklist.done: every Filed line links to a complete, retention-labelled confirmation folder.

checklist.step: Monitor post-filing regulator queries
actions: Log any BMA or state question on a transmitted filing as a case with the stated response date (default 14 days).
Route figure-level questions to the Controller and valuation questions to the Appointed Actuary (REG-057-C10).
Track responses to transmission and file them with the original filing folder.
Escalate queries implying a filing deficiency to General Counsel.
checklist.done: post-filing queries are cased, answered on time and filed with the original package.

checklist.step: Log and remediate filing exceptions
actions: Raise an issue for any late transmission, ungranted extension reliance, rejection or late fee, recording civil-penalty exposure under the Act.
Assign root cause (package slip, portal failure, calendar error) and a remediation owner.
Obtain CFO sign-off at closure, with General Counsel co-signature on s.18 late filings.
Report the exception summary to the audit committee each quarter.
checklist.done: every exception is tracked with penalty exposure, signed closure and committee reporting.

checklist.step: Close the filing season with a completeness review
actions: After April 30, verify every calendar line shows Filed with a receipt or a granted extension with its new date.
Reconcile the tracker against the BMA portal's submission history for each entity.
Summarize the season (filings made, lates, extensions, rejections) to the CFO and Head of Compliance.
Roll lessons learned into next year's calendar build.
checklist.done: a season-close review confirms every line resolved and is reported to the CFO.

checklist.step: Track regulatory change to filing requirements
actions: Monitor BMA notices each quarter for changes to filing deadlines, portal procedures, fee schedules or package contents.
Assess each change against the calendar and procedure and record the assessment.
Update the calendar and completeness checklist before the next affected filing.
Brief the reporting team on landed changes at the pre-season meeting.
checklist.done: quarterly change assessments exist and landed changes reach the calendar before they bite.

testing.step: Build the population of due filings
actions: Extract the locked filing calendar with due dates, owners and status for the season under test.
Independently rebuild the due list from statute and registration certificates: SFR per Bermuda entity at year end plus 4 months, fees at March 31, class quarterlies, NAIC dates per US affiliate.
Any due filing absent from the calendar is an automatic exception.
testing.done: an independently rebuilt due list reconciles to the calendar or gaps are exceptions.

testing.step: Reconcile Filed status to portal records
actions: For each Bermuda entity, compare the tracker's Filed lines to the BMA portal's submission history.
For US affiliates, compare to the NAIC filing status records.
List any tracker/portal mismatch as an exception.
testing.done: tracker status matches regulator-side records for every entity.

testing.step: Recompute timeliness on 100% of filings
actions: Recompute each SFR receipt timestamp against year end plus 4 months or the granted extension date on file.
Recompute fee value dates against March 31, quarterlies against class deadlines, and NAIC filings against March 1 / 45-day rules.
Quantify every late in days and verify a granted extension letter exists where relied upon.
testing.done: every filing's day-count is recomputed with lates quantified and extensions evidenced.

testing.step: Verify package content for one sampled SFR
actions: Open the sampled entity's transmitted package manifest and confirmation folder.
Verify each required component was present: audited statutory statements, GAAP statements with opinion, BSCR schedules, actuarial opinion and the executed Declaration of Compliance.
Verify component version ids match the certified sets in the financial reporting repository.
testing.done: the transmitted package matches the certified sources component for component.

testing.step: Re-perform the completeness checklist
actions: Re-run the BMA-instruction completeness checklist against the sampled package without reference to the preparer's ticks.
Compare conclusions to the signed checklist on file.
Any component the preparer ticked that was absent is an exception.
testing.done: an independent checklist run matches the preparer's or discrepancies are logged.

testing.step: Verify the second-person authorization control
actions: For each tested filing, check the transmission authorization signature exists and pre-dates the portal receipt.
Confirm the authorizer and transmitter are different people.
List unauthorized or self-authorized transmissions as exceptions.
testing.done: every filing shows a segregated, pre-transmission authorization.

testing.step: Trace extensions and rejections to proper handling
actions: For every extension relied on, verify the request pre-dates the statutory deadline and a written BMA grant exists.
For every rejection, verify the cure and resubmission landed within 5 business days.
List post-deadline requests or slow cures as exceptions.
testing.done: extensions were pre-deadline and granted; rejections were cured within 5 days.

testing.step: Verify fee payment evidence
actions: Trace each entity's fee payment to the treasury confirmation and the BMA receipt.
Verify the amount against the BMA fee schedule for the entity's class.
Recompute the value date against March 31.
testing.done: fees trace to confirmed, correctly sized, on-time payments.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause and owner
actions: Raise one issue per exception naming the entity, filing and failed attribute.
Assign root cause (calendar gap, package slip, authorization gap, fee miss) and an owner.
Route any uncured late filing to the CFO and General Counsel same-day given s.18 penalty exposure.
Set remediation dates and carry open items into next season's test.
testing.done: all exceptions are tracked with root cause, owner and penalty-exposure escalation.

testing.step: Conclude with independent sign-off
actions: State the conclusion against the zero-late-filing threshold: effective, effective with exceptions, or ineffective.
Have the Chief Audit Executive, who transmitted nothing, sign the workpaper.
Report to the audit committee and the CFO before the next calendar build.
File the workpaper under REG-057/C16/testing.
testing.done: a signed conclusion is filed and reported before next season's calendar is built.
